svg.title: Here the linear coefficient is exactly bhβ = −g−1(Aμ + b), since Ssleepμ = 0. The last term is the reference Gaussian, the preceding quadratic term its itinerary correction and the linear term its first correction. Ghost supplies the dormant diagonal with normalized integral one. This pointwise identity holds regardless of later profile zeros or sector events. The lift retains the same count coordinates and every exponent term before any integration.
